title: Asynchronous Fine-Tuning Pipelines
summary: Run data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, and model promotion as a durable offline workflow with explicit quality gates and lineage.
overview: Asynchronous fine-tuning pipelines separate training work from user-facing inference. Feedback and approved examples enter a durable preparation process; training jobs run independently; candidate artifacts are evaluated before any serving change. A user interaction can contribute a reviewable example without immediately modifying the deployed model.

The pipeline’s key invariant is controlled promotion. New weights or adapters should never become production simply because a training job completed. Dataset provenance, privacy handling, leakage prevention, baseline comparisons, and serving compatibility are part of the artifact’s lineage. Automatic scheduling is compatible with strict gates; unrestricted self-training from raw conversations is not required.

production.poc: A prototype runs a small reproducible dataset through training and held-out evaluation without touching the live endpoint.
production.production: Production adds durable job state, dataset approval, retryable stages, artifact registration, and canary promotion.
production.scale: Enterprise scale manages compute quotas, multiple candidate branches, deletion and retention requirements, and reproducible rollback across data, model, adapter, and runtime versions.

components.name: Feedback intake
components.role: Collects approved corrections and outcomes with consent, provenance, and review status.

components.name: Dataset builder
components.role: Cleans examples, removes prohibited data, deduplicates, and creates leakage-resistant splits.

components.name: Training orchestrator
components.role: Schedules durable jobs and records checkpoints, resources, and configuration.

components.name: Evaluation gate
components.role: Compares candidates with the deployed baseline on task, safety, and regression suites.

components.name: Artifact registry and release controller
components.role: Stores complete lineage and promotes only approved serving bundles.

flow.title: Collect reviewable examples
flow.description: Ingest feedback as candidates with source and permission metadata rather than immediate training truth.

flow.title: Build a frozen dataset
flow.description: Apply quality review, redaction, deduplication, and stable train-validation-test partitions.

flow.title: Schedule training
flow.description: Submit an idempotent job under resource limits and record the full configuration.

flow.title: Register the candidate
flow.description: Store weights or adapters with base-model, data, code, and runtime lineage.

flow.title: Evaluate and gate
flow.description: Require held-out improvements and acceptable critical-slice behavior before release eligibility.

flow.title: Canary and observe
flow.description: Promote a small traffic cohort, compare live outcomes, and roll back the complete bundle if needed.

useCase.title: Learning from reviewed resolution corrections
useCase.situation: A support organization reviews assistant drafts and records corrected troubleshooting summaries.
useCase.problem: Useful corrections accumulate, but manually retraining and deploying models is slow and inconsistent.
useCase.requirement: Turn approved corrections into reproducible candidate adaptations without feeding raw customer conversations directly into production learning.
useCase.architecture: A governed dataset builder creates periodic snapshots, and asynchronous adapter jobs feed a registry and evaluation gate.
runtime: Reviewed corrections enter a versioned dataset after privacy and quality checks.
A candidate is evaluated on unseen product issues and canaried only if critical troubleshooting behavior remains acceptable.
useCase.failure: If a training job retries after a worker failure, the job identity prevents duplicate promotion; if evaluation regresses, the deployed model remains unchanged.
useCase.impact: Measure dataset acceptance, reproducibility, held-out quality, training cost, and post-release correction rate; job completion throughput alone says little about useful model improvement.

tradeoffs.benefit: Decouples compute-heavy adaptation from user latency.
Respond to reviewed behavior gaps sooner.

tradeoffs.cost: Can delay release when evidence is incomplete.

failures.detection: Unreviewed or sensitive examples appear in the dataset manifest.
failures.recovery: Quarantine affected data and rebuild from approved sources.

failures.detection: Training and test share source-derived examples.
failures.recovery: Repartition by lineage or time and rerun independent evaluation.

mistakes.fix: Require explicit quality and serving gates.
Store immutable manifests and transformation versions.
Evaluate the exact base, adapter, tokenizer, and runtime bundle.

whenToUse: Use for recurring adaptation from reviewed examples.
Use when training must not block serving.
Use when reproducibility and rollback are operational requirements.
whenNotToUse: Do not fine-tune merely to refresh changing facts.
Avoid automated promotion without meaningful held-out evaluation.
checklist: Canary and retain a tested rollback bundle.
